subject: maths
question:
Calculate the mode of the following data. (Round off to two decimal places)

 
 

 Marks
 4-8
 8-12
 12-16
 16-20
 20-24
 24-28
 28-32
 32-36
 
 

 No. of Students
 9
 12
 18
 34
 26
 20
 12
 7
solution:
**Given:**

Modal class = 16–20

f₁ = 34

f₀ = 18

f₂ = 26

Class width (h) = 4

Lower limit (l) = 16

**Formula Used:**

Mode = l + [(f₁ − f₀) ÷ (2f₁ − f₀ − f₂)] × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mode = 16 + [(34 − 18) ÷ (2×34 − 18 − 26)] × 4

⇒ Mode = 16 + [16 ÷ (68 − 44)] × 4

⇒ Mode = 16 + (16 ÷ 24) × 4

⇒ Mode = 16 + (2 ÷ 3) × 4

⇒ Mode = 16 + 2.67

⇒ Mode = 18.67

**∴ The correct answer is 18.67.**
